title: release-health report
description: The machine-readable report `release-health.measure` writes as release-health-<version>.json (dl-089 §1, §6). One entry per catalogue metric, in catalogue order; raw counts beside every percentage. Written by scripts/release-health/measure.cjs; read by compare.cjs, which writes release-health-<version>.md (report-layout.md).

schema_version.description: This schema's version; bumped on an incompatible change.

catalogue_version.description: The `version` of metrics.yaml the run measured with.

id.description: The release element's id, e.g. minor-v0.3.

kind.description: D01 and P06 are measured on major and minor releases only.

ref.description: The published tag (e.g. v0.2.1), or the released transition commit when publishing did not run.

basis.description: dl-089 §1: a tag whose publish failed is never a measurement point.

previous.description: The previous run's measurement point; null on the first run (every metric is then `new`).

report.description: Repository-relative path of the previous JSON report.

status.description: not-comparable: D01/P06 on a patch release.

reason.description: Required unless status is measured: why no value was taken.

value.description: The metric's value: a number, a boolean (pass/fail floors), or an object for a multi-part metric (e.g. G03 median/p90/share).

raw.description: The raw counts behind every percentage (e.g. { "numerator": 41, "denominator": 50 }), so the value can be recomputed by hand (dl-089 §6).

items.description: Relevant items in the window; under the catalogue's small_sample the metric is flagged.

failing.description: For a floor (and every P measure): each failing item, named (a commit sha, a file, an element id).

command.description: The command that produced the value.

read_on.description: The date a value was read, for the external E metrics and D01 (dl-130, dl-089 §2).

wingfoil_build.description: D01/P06: the WingFoil build the runs used.
